extraction.name: Self-Contradictory Instructions (SCI)
extraction.description: A multimodal benchmark to evaluate the ability of large multimodal models to detect self-contradictory instructions. It comprises 20,000 conflicts evenly distributed between language-language and vision-language paradigms, covering 8 tasks.
extraction.creator: Jin Gao, Lei Gan, Yuankai Li, Yixin Ye, Dequan Wang
extraction.citeAs: Gao, J., Gan, L., Li, Y., Ye, Y., & Wang, D. (2024). Dissecting Dissonance: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models Against Self-Contradictory Instructions. arXiv:2408.01091v2.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed using a novel automatic dataset creation framework called AutoCreate. AutoCreate starts from a small batch of manually input seeds and maintains a seed pool. In each iteration, it runs a Language Loop and a Visual Loop, each processed by a fully automated Generator, Decorator, and Cleaner. The Generator creates initial language or vision data, the Decorator creates self-contradictions in the generated data, and the Cleaner removes data that does not meet quality standards. The resulting dataset is refined to extract new seeds for re-entry into the seed pool. Both human experts and LLMs are involved in double-checking quality, and human experts rigorously checked the final AutoCreate-generated SCI dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Experiments, Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset is generated from manually input seeds, programs, and large language models through the AutoCreate framework. For vision-language conflicts, images are programmatically generated for OCRConflict, FigureConflict, and GeometricConflict. SemanticConflict uses external data from the ImageNet dataset, retrieving images from the ImageNet-1k validation set.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For V-L conflicts, the image caption is modified to introduce a conflict. FigureConflict manipulates numerical data by changing the maximum value to the minimum value before plotting charts. GeometricConflict modifies phrases to refer to non-existent objects. SemanticConflict substitutes the correct class label in questions with similar but different objects. More generally, the Decorator stage creates self-contradictions in generated data, and the Cleaner excludes data that does not meet standards.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: AutoCreate includes a Cleaner that removes data that does not meet quality standards. The resulting high-quality dataset is refined to extract new seeds for re-entry into the seed pool. Both human experts and LLMs double-check generated data quality, and human experts rigorously checked the final dataset. The dataset is also manually split into SCI-Core (1%), SCI-Base (10%), and SCI-All (100%) according to the occurring frequency of conflict types, with subsets selected manually.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The paper does not describe conventional item-level human labeling for dataset examples. Human experts and LLMs are involved in double-checking the quality of generated data. For evaluation of model replies on the benchmark, replies were evaluated to determine whether they successfully identified the conflict hidden in the user input; this evaluation was conducted by human experts and also by LLM agents such as GPT-4.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper analyzes agreement between LLM evaluation agents and human experts. For vision-language conflicts, Spearman correlation coefficient and concordance rate were calculated between LLM-agent evaluations and human evaluations, showing close alignment. The paper reports, for example, GPT-4 as an evaluation agent aligning closely with human evaluative standards.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper states that SCI, AutoCreate, and CaP have significant social implications. SCI provides researchers and practitioners with a standardized platform to assess and enhance LMMs' ability to navigate conflicting instructions, advancing human-computer interaction and communication technologies. AutoCreate facilitates creation of diverse instruction datasets, promoting inclusivity in AI research. CaP integrates external cognition into multimodal models, enhancing context-aware understanding. By improving dissonance detection, the approach is said to boost LMM performance and foster trust and reliability in AI systems, which the authors describe as essential for societal integration.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper notes that only SemanticConflict involves external data, ImageNet. It also states that different model performances may be due to differences in training data. No explicit dataset bias analysis for SCI itself is otherwise provided.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark only includes language-language and vision-language paradigms. The authors state that more modalities will be included in the future based on AutoCreate. No fine-grained control is introduced to determine the conflict degree. The paper also does not provide a detailed study on the attention mechanism of large multimodal models when confronted with conflict instructions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed as a benchmark to evaluate the capability of large multimodal models to comprehend and detect conflicting instructions effectively. It is used for assessing self-contradictory instruction detection across language-language and vision-language tasks, including evaluation on SCI-Core, SCI-Base, and SCI-All.
